purpose: Compose fixed prepared leptonic nodes across supplied phase-space quadrature without averaging normalized asymmetries.

fixed_weights.domain: Finite nonnegative Float64 quadrature/acceptance/cross-section weights; each category has nonzero support. No fitted or signed quadrature weights.
fixed_weights.normalization: Supply the full differential cross-section prefactor, quadrature/Jacobian and acceptance once. A common global normalization cancels. No unit normalization or missing-prefactor inference.
fixed_weights.SIDIS: One vector w_i. For the dx dy dz d2P measure in Eq.3 it includes sigma0(x,y,Q2), proportional to [1+(1-y)^2]/(y*Q2). A change of integration coordinates requires its Jacobian. Fixed-point source DNN/phase stays in each node's angular factor a_i.
fixed_weights.SIA: An N-by-2 matrix w_iU,w_iL includes quadrature, cross-section prefactor proportional to (1+cos(theta)^2)/Q2 and supplied category acceptance. A point-angle node a_i=sin(theta)^2/(1+cos(theta)^2) retains the angular correlation. A source-averaged angular scalar is valid only under an independently reviewed conditional averaging/factorization prescription.
fixed_weights.momentum: Each node is either a point or an existing finite-P integral. Do not apply its P*dP Jacobian again. Mixing point and P-integrated nodes is rejected. Other phase-space measures and dependencies are caller supplied.

SIDIS: A_bin=sum_i(w_i*a_i*N_i)/sum_i(w_i*D_i). The source phase and DNN convention must agree across nodes, while fixed y may vary. DNN(mean(y)) is not substituted for the weighted numerator. An event-level DNN correction or division by an averaged DNN requires a separately derived experimental adapter.

SIA.integrals: N_U=sum_i(w_iU*a_i*N_iU); D_U=sum_i(w_iU*D_iU); likewise L. C is the sum of integrated U and L yields, not a third independent sample.
SIA.approximation: Same linearized double-ratio convention as the parent; no exact nonlinear-ratio Fourier coefficient. Category-dependent fixed acceptance weights are explicit. All node angular-source definitions must agree.

invariants: All nodes share process, model/settings, flavor basis, target, pion charge, phase and normalization convention; Q2, x, z, y, P and allowed conditional angular factors may vary.
Preparation owns the weights and node vector; complete typed snapshots guard all weight entries, integrated denominators, metadata and each node. Descendant row/source checks remain mandatory.
At each parameter value all fitted evaluation and derivatives remain in Julia. No native evolution, provider, Python or language-model calls occur inside evaluation.
Signed polarized numerators remain signed. Require finite positive integrated unpolarized yields. Do not clamp predictions or insert acceptance/data-admission defaults.

synthetic_joint_acceptance.scope: synthetic mathematical quadrature only; closed integrals are independent of the implemented bin projector; no experimental acceptance claim

validation_policy.policy_origin: Reuse the unchanged parent algebra, analytic, physical and derivative targets; freeze before validation. Fixed finite-sum checks do not establish quadrature, acceptance or underlying evolution accuracy.

limitations: No experimental candidate, historical or updated fit is admitted; all production flags remain false.
This interface consumes explicit prepared nodes and fixed weights; it does not recover an experiment's joint acceptance, kinematic correlations, covariance or overlap.
No automatic beam relation, phase-space support, low-transverse-momentum cut, unit conversion or conditional angular-measure inference. Those belong to a reviewed source adapter.
Finite node composition alone is not a multidimensional quadrature-convergence certificate. Reference comparisons sharing fixed native rows do not independently validate evolution.
All parent original-code, Collins-evolution, source-extrapolation, performance and interval-coverage limitations remain.
